title: demand_weight now silently drives growth spawn composition, but the data file documents it only as the director pick weight
evidence: core/growth.odin:135 `append(&weights, max(1, nt.demand_weight))` under comment "// demand_weight floored at 1 (weighted_pick skips non-positive weights)."; data/node_types.json _comment documents only "demand_weight (Story 3.1) = the terminal's relative attractor weight for weighted-random dst selection (v1 §3.3); terminals only, default 1 (uniform)."; new campus row carries "demand_weight": 4 (data/node_types.json:73) while residential/content_host stay 1.
detail: One field now controls two systems. With weights 1/2/1/4, ~50% of era-3 growth spawns are campuses; a future tuner adjusting dst attractiveness silently re-balances map composition, and vice versa.
recommended_fix: Document the growth-pick role in node_types.json's demand_weight field comment (or split a growth_weight field at the next deliberate re-bless).

title: small_biz joins the era-2 growth roster but no era-2 demand entry sources from or sinks to it — inert buildings until era 3
evidence: data/node_types.json:64 small_biz "era_introduced": 2; data/demand.json era-2 entries contain only one entry "class_id": "email", "source_role": "residential", "sink_role": "residential"; core/growth_test.odin:295 pins `testing.expectf(t, len(r2) == 2 && has_small_biz, "era-2 roster must hold residential + small_biz, got %d types", len(r2))`.
detail: When the era-FSM story activates era 2, growth places offices that neither emit nor receive traffic — visibly inert roster entries. PR defers this to the era-FSM re-tune; nothing tracks it.
recommended_fix: Add the era-2 small_biz demand entry to the era-FSM story's checklist (or gate small_biz to era 3 until that re-tune).

title: 5.11 profile numbers now restated in three places (data JSON, test_catalog, pinned milli expectations) with no cross-check
evidence: data/node_types.json: "throughput_units": 150 / "demand_weight": 4; core/determinism_test.odin:47 `append(&cat.node_types, Node_Type{id = "campus", ... throughput_units = 150, port_capacity = 0, demand_weight = 4, era_introduced = 3})`; core/demand_test.odin:384 `testing.expect_value(t, spawn_credit_accrue_milli(cat, camp_idx), u32(2500))`.
detail: ODN-5 says numbers live in data only. The pre-existing test_catalog mirror was extended; re-tuning campus throughput now requires synchronized edits in three files or unit pins silently test stale values.
recommended_fix: Add one test that parses the real data/node_types.json and asserts parity with test_catalog's profile fields (ids, throughput, weight, era).

title: sprite_index_building's #partial switch falls through to house variants — a future unwired role silently renders as a house
detail: Adding a role (e.g. data_center) without touching this proc compiles clean and renders it as a house — E9.1 (distinct shape per type) silently violated, and a T2 re-bless would bless the wrong shape.
recommended_fix: Use a total switch with an explicit `.None, .Residential: return int(id % 4)` case so a new role is a compile error here, forcing the sprite wiring.
